note: Process names that make the HUD suspend itself. NONE of these were confirmed on a machine with the software installed; the only web-sourced name is LockDown.exe (one third-party file database). Confirm each in Task Manager > Details while the app runs, then set 'verified' to true. Extensions (Honorlock, Proctorio) are not processes: the HUD cannot see them, and they run inside Chrome, which the HUD does not touch.
